answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. Each identity locks a 100-credit jade bond, released as behavior accrues: a sonnet of fourteen tasks, auditors stamp each with timing. A forger must wander the same fourteen tasks per fake, forging fresh prints; rented prints fail: one bond, one key. 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 credits plus 14,000 forged records against a 40,000-credit pool; one honest agent locks one bond and earns it back.
